exposure: surgical vs nonsurgical vs possible-surgical indication
outcome: types of antibiotics prescribed (broad-spectrum, fixed-dose combinations)
cohort: The cohort comprised 5558 inpatients admitted to obstetrics and gynaecology departments of two tertiary care hospitals (one teaching and one non-teaching) in Central India.
finding: Antibiotics were frequently prescribed to patients in OBGY departments, often without documented infectious indications, with broad-spectrum fixed-dose combination antibiotics commonly misprescribed, especially in the non-teaching hospital.
